resources.string: Connect your Zotero library to open papers\' PDFs here and write on them. Opened papers are saved in a \"Zotero\" folder in your notes.
On zotero.org, create a private key with \"Allow library access\" checked, then paste it below.
Use the same address, username and password as in Zotero\'s Sync settings.
Your key and WebDAV details will be removed from this device. Notes you\'ve made from Zotero papers stay where they are.
xnotes only connects while you use this page, and only to Zotero and the WebDAV address you entered. Your key and password are stored encrypted on this device.
The WebDAV address must start with https://.
Choose a notes folder on Home first.
